Calibrate GLM Interaction for a Target Subgroup Effect Size

Source: R/calibrate_glm_interaction.R
calibrate_glm_interaction.Rd

Searches over a grid of interaction multipliers (k_inter) to find the value that produces a target effect size in the subgroup \(Q\). Returns a modified "glm_dgm" object with the calibrated interaction and updated true effects.

Usage

calibrate_glm_interaction(
  data,
  factor_vars,
  continuous_vars = NULL,
  outcome_var,
  treatment_var,
  target_effect,
  outcome_type = c("binary", "continuous", "count"),
  effect_measure = NULL,
  offset_var = NULL,
  subgroup_vars = NULL,
  subgroup_cuts = NULL,
  k_treat = 1,
  adverse_outcome = FALSE,
  k_inter_range = c(-10, 10),
  grid_step = 0.05,
  tol_rel = 2.5,
  n_super = 5000L,
  seed = 8316951L,
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

data

The source data frame (same as passed to generate_glm_dgm).

factor_vars

Character vector of factor variable names.

continuous_vars

Character vector of continuous prognostic variable names. Passed through to generate_glm_dgm. Default NULL.

outcome_var

Character string naming the outcome variable.

treatment_var

Character string naming the treatment variable.

target_effect

Numeric. Target effect size in Q on the scale determined by effect_measure (e.g., OR = 2.0 for a binary outcome).

outcome_type

Character. One of "binary", "continuous", or "count".

effect_measure

Character. Effect measure. Default NULL (selects default per outcome_type).

offset_var

Character or NULL. Name of the exposure / follow-up time column for count outcomes with an offset (IRR, IRD). Default NULL.

subgroup_vars

Character vector of subgroup-defining variables.

subgroup_cuts

Named list of cutpoint specifications.

k_treat

Numeric. Treatment effect scaling factor passed to generate_glm_dgm. Default 1 (preserve fitted treatment effect). Set to 0 to zero out the ITT effect.

adverse_outcome

Logical. When TRUE for binary outcomes with a ratio effect measure (OR, RR), the calibration searches for 1 / target_effect on the actual Y scale because generate_glm_dgm negates k_inter internally. The returned DGM stores adverse_outcome = TRUE so that downstream functions (e.g., run_simulation_analysis) can auto-coordinate the analysis direction. Default FALSE.

k_inter_range

Numeric vector of length 2. Search range for k_inter. Default c(0, 10).

grid_step

Numeric. Grid resolution. Default 0.05.

tol_rel

Numeric. Maximum tolerated relative error, in percent; the call stops (fails loudly) if the achieved OR is not within tol_rel percent of the target. Default 2.5.

n_super

Integer. Super-population size. Default 5000L.

seed

Integer. Random seed. Default 8316951L.

verbose

Logical. Print calibration progress. Default FALSE.

Value

An object of class "glm_dgm" with the calibrated k_inter and updated hazard_ratios.

Details

The function constructs a grid of k_inter values, calls generate_glm_dgm for each, and selects the value whose subgroup effect is closest to target_effect.

For binary outcomes with effect_measure = "OR", the target is on the switched-treatment OR scale (OR > 1 = treatment increases the outcome).

See also

generate_glm_dgm, simulate_from_glm_dgm

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
dgm <- calibrate_glm_interaction(
  data          = actg_df,
  factor_vars   = paste0("z", 1:12),
  outcome_var   = "y_binary",
  treatment_var = "treat",
  target_effect = 2.0,
  outcome_type  = "binary",
  subgroup_vars = c("z1", "z2"),
  subgroup_cuts = list(z1 = 1L, z2 = 1L),
  verbose       = TRUE
)
print(dgm)
} # }
